source: https://zed.dev/ (browsed live 2026-08-02, light + dark, 1440px viewport, full-page scroll-through)
also browsed: /ai, /blog, /blog/hidden-gems-part-4, /docs, /pricing, /extensions, /download, 404 page, Product/Resources nav dropdowns, footer
verified via live computed-style probes, Tailwind v4 CSS bundle token extraction, and JS bundle shader-source inspection (28 GLSL #version 300 es programs)

color.palette_type: two custom neutral families (warm 'cream' paper + cool 'offgray' ink) crossed with a single saturated 'Zed blue'; Tailwind default scales held in reserve for semantic state; dark mode flips to a cool blue-charcoal
color.primary_accent: #1348dc (--color-accent-blue; verified: hero h1 color, primary button fill, footer block, links, blue serif headlines)
color.accent_dark_variant: rgb(5,55,148) — inset bottom-edge shadow on primary buttons; blue-400 #54a2ff / blue-300 #90c5ff take over headline/link roles in dark mode

paper_neutrals.observed: marketing body bg is cream-100 at 20% opacity over white → a warm paper off-white ≈ #f7f6f4; pure white is never the page color

ink_neutrals.usage: body text = offgray-700 #535964 (verified oklch(0.359 0.0155 262.9)); muted/meta text = offgray-500; hairline borders = offgray at 20% alpha; dark-mode body text = offgray-300 #abafb8; headings are pure black or accent blue, never gray

color.blue_tints: blue-50 #eff6ff … blue-500 #3080ff … blue-950 #162456 (Tailwind scale); blue-50/blue-100 fills ghost buttons ('Download Now' on /download), selected segmented-control tabs, 'Newest' badges, focused inputs
color.semantic: success green-500 #00c758, warning amber-500 #f99c00, error = Tailwind red scale, info = blue; note: pricing feature checkmarks render in accent blue, not green — blue does most positive-signal work

dark_mode.background: hsl(218, 13%, 7.5%) — verified body class dark:bg-[hsl(218,13%,7.5%)]; a blue-tinted charcoal, not pure black
dark_mode.accent: blue lightens (hero serif headline renders ~blue-300/400); shader canvases dim from opacity-15 to opacity-8

color.surface_hierarchy: paper cream page → white/cream-50 hairline-bordered cards → blue-50 tinted interactive fills → solid #1348dc primary surfaces (buttons, footer)
color.contrast_strategy: dark slate ink on warm paper at comfortable AA contrast; hierarchy by ink weight (black heading → offgray-700 body → offgray-500 meta); blue reserved for headlines, links, CTAs, and the footer block — never decoration on body text; customer logo clouds are grayscale

typography.heading_font: IBM Plex Serif VARIABLE — loaded as 'plexSerif'; used for every display headline, section statement, blog/docs page title, price numerals, version numbers; variable weights observed 340–390 (thin, editorial)
typography.body_font: iA Writer Quattro S — loaded as 'writer'; a QUASI-PROPORTIONAL TYPEWRITER face that sets all UI text: nav, buttons, body copy, feature lists, blog prose, docs body (verified: body font-family 'writer' 16px/24px; blog/docs prose 14px/20px)
typography.mono_font: Lilex ('zed-mono', an IBM Plex Mono derivative with ligatures) for code; ui-monospace/SFMono stack for kbd keycaps and small meta (verified kbd: 11px, ls -0.35px)
typography.sans_font: IBM Plex Sans loaded as 'plexSans' — used inside product-UI/theme-preview mockups rather than marketing chrome

scale_observed.hero_h1: 48px Plex Serif italic, weight 340, lh 57.6px, ls -0.96px, accent blue (verified)
scale_observed.section_h2: 25.6px Plex Serif, weight 390, lh 32px — black or blue (verified)
scale_observed.docs_h1: ~32px Plex Serif blue ('Getting Started'); docs h2 black serif with hairline underline
scale_observed.nav_buttons: 16px writer 400; CTA buttons 14px writer with ls -0.35px (verified)

typography.tracking: tightens on small UI text (-0.35px at 11–14px) and display serif (-0.96px at 48px); Tailwind tracking tokens -0.025em…0.1em available; uppercase mono labels get wide tracking
typography.font_style_notes: the signature pairing: elegant variable-weight Plex Serif (often italic, often blue) for statements + typewriter-flavored iA Writer Quattro for everything else — 'editorial romance set by a machine'. Serif italic = brand voice moments; serif roman = section statements; writer = the product's engineering texture

spacing.content_density: comfortable-compact inside a strict frame — text blocks are narrow and information-dense, but every band gets generous vertical air (hero sections run min-h ~448px)
spacing.section_rhythm: the page frame does the rhythm: full-width hairline rules separate bands; ~80-96px vertical padding per marketing section; tight 8-16px stacks inside feature cells

layout.grid_system: everything lives inside 'the page': a centered 1280px-max frame with visible 1px hairline left/right borders; ruler tick marks run down the outer margins like a drafting sheet; inner content column is 1120px (verified: container-max-w = 1120px centered in 1280px frame)
layout.columns: 3-col feature rows (Fast/Agentic/Collaborative) split by hairlines; 2-col then 3-col screenshot grids; 4-col extension cards; 5-col footer link block; alternating text+screenshot feature rows
layout.gutter: 80px frame-to-content gutters at desktop; cards 16-24px gaps
layout.breakpoints: sm 640px (Tailwind default set; mobile collapses the frame to full-bleed)
layout.alignment_tendency: centered hero statements (serif headline + subcopy + CTA pair) inside a strict left-aligned grid; docs = classic 3-pane (left sidebar nav / 740px prose / right 'On This Page' rail)
layout.signature_chrome: sticky top nav with Z logo + text links + search/⌘P + 'Sign up S'/'Download D' keycap buttons; centered text-only announcement bar ('Early Access: DeltaDB… →') on a hairline-separated strip; pages close with a SOLID ACCENT-BLUE footer block (white 5-col links) — the loudest surface on the site

shape.border_radius: xs 2px (kbd keycaps) / sm 4px (buttons — verified) / md 6px / lg 8px / xl 12px (cards, code blocks, inputs) / 2xl 16px; app icon ~24px continuous corner; pills reserved for toggles/badges and the 'Watch Demo' floater
shape.border_usage: hairline 1px offgray-at-20%-alpha borders EVERYWHERE — the page frame, section rules, card frames, button outlines, input borders; borders and tonal steps do all the structural work
shape.divider_style: 1px hairlines, often full-bleed across the frame; docs h2s get hairline underlines; the frame's corner intersections get tiny crosshair/tick details

elevation.shadow_style: nearly flat; depth comes from hairlines and tonal layers, with two deliberate exceptions

levels.low: primary button: inset 0 -2px 0 0 rgb(5,55,148) (a darker blue bottom edge — a physical KEYCAP press feel) + 0 1px 3px rgb(230,239,254) soft blue halo (verified computed)
levels.medium: cards/inputs sit flat on hairlines; segmented control selected tab gets a white raised chip
levels.high: product screenshots and the Z app icon float with soft diffused shadows (shadow-xl, offgray-500/20; app icon on a thick rounded squircle)

elevation.depth_cues: hairline borders > tonal surface steps > rare soft shadows; the keycap inset edge is the one tactile skeuomorph

iconography.style: small 16px stroke line icons (download arrows, search magnifier, platform glyphs, author/download-count meta icons) + keyboard glyphs (⌘ S D C) as first-class iconography
iconography.stroke_weight: ~1.5px, round caps; icon set is minimal and functional
iconography.size_scale: 11-16px inline with text; 24px in feature cells
iconography.preferred_set: custom inline SVGs; the Zed 'Z-in-a-blueprint-square' logo mark recurs (nav, footer, loading states)

motion.duration_scale: micro 150ms state changes / normal 300-400ms (page-frame transform runs 400ms) / macro = continuous ambient shader loops
motion.entrance_pattern: fade-up utility (--animate-fade-up) on scroll-revealed sections; content bands materialize as you approach
motion.philosophy: functional and instant like the editor itself; ambient motion is delegated to the low-opacity WebGL backgrounds (plus spin-slow 32s/50s decorative rotations) so the content layer stays perfectly still

components.button_primary: solid #1348dc, white 14px writer text, 4px radius, inset darker-blue bottom edge + blue halo shadow = a keyboard keycap; ALWAYS pairs the label with a kbd shortcut hint ('Download now D')
components.button_secondary: paper/white fill, hairline border, dark text, keycap hint ('Clone source C'); blue-tinted variant (blue-50 fill, blue text) for download actions and selected tabs
components.kbd_keycaps: 11px mono glyphs in 2px-radius white/50 chips with 1px border — appear inside nav buttons, CTAs, search field (⌘P), docs shortcuts (Cmd+O); the site's most repeated component motif
components.nav: 64px sticky bar inside the frame; text links with chevron dropdowns; right side: search icon + ⌘P keycap, ghost 'Sign up S', solid 'Download D'
components.segmented_control: hairline-bordered pill container, white raised selected segment ('Stable/Preview' on /download)
components.cards: flat paper/white cards, 1px hairline, 8-12px radius; blog cards carry near-black generative-art covers + title + excerpt + avatar/author + mono date; extension cards = name + download count + description + author in a 4-col grid; pricing cards = mono uppercase plan label, serif blue price, blue-check feature list, CTA at bottom (Pro card gets a soft blue glow ring)
components.blog_index: category sidebar ('CATEGORIES' mono overline, blue-text active item) + post rows separated by hairlines with tiny author avatar and right-aligned mono dates
components.docs: 3-pane layout; serif blue page title; writer body; kbd-styled shortcuts inline; hairline-boxed code blocks with copy affordance; right 'On This Page' rail; llms.txt / markdown-version links for agents
components.inputs: white fields, hairline border, 8-12px radius, italic placeholder (newsletter email); ⌘K/S keycap hints in search boxes
components.footer: solid #1348dc block across the frame, white writer-font links in 5 columns (Product/Resources/Company/Social), copyright + legal line; preceded by a centered 'Daily drive with Zed' serif CTA band
components.announcement_bar: centered single line, blue text link with →, hairline separated; in dark mode becomes a navy strip

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a draftsman's sheet: the whole site is one sheet of grid paper pinned inside a hairline frame with ruler ticks, typeset by a typewriter, annotated in blue serif ink
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary dev-tool minimalism (Linear/Raycast lineage) crossed with print editorial typography and CAD/blueprint drafting furniture
aesthetic.genre: developer-tool marketing with an editorial serif twist — 'typewriter chic'

visual_language.complexity: minimal surface, rich subtext — flat hairline layouts carrying five custom fonts and live shader grain
visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents only: ruler ticks, grid-paper margins, keycap chips, faint animated shader wash; nothing decorative exceeds ~15% opacity
visual_language.whitespace_usage: structured air — generous vertical bands compressed into a strict 1120px column; whitespace is framed, never boundless
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: light paper fields punctuated by dark product screenshots and one heavy blue footer; serif headlines act as thin ink accents rather than black masses
visual_language.focal_strategy: single centered statement per band (serif headline → one-line subcopy → keycap CTA pair), then hairline-gridded proof (screenshots, quotes, tables)
visual_language.contrast_level: moderate; ink-on-paper body with high-contrast blue accents and near-black imagery blocks
visual_language.texture_usage: paper grain + blueprint grid + shader noise at very low opacity; texture replaces color as the site's richness budget

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic hierarchy first (serif display > writer body > mono meta), then hairline structure; color is the final accent, not the organizer
composition.balance_type: symmetric centered heroes over asymmetric alternating feature rows
composition.flow_direction: strict vertical scroll through hairline-banded chapters; the frame's side rules keep the eye railed
composition.grouping_strategy: hairline-divided cells and bands instead of floating cards; related items share a ruled cell
composition.negative_space_role: margins are ACTIVE space — they carry the ruler ticks, grid paper, and shader wash that make the frame feel drafted

imagery.photo_treatment: no photography; people appear only as small round avatars in testimonials
imagery.illustration_style: vector-drafting line art — the 404 page draws its digits as blue pen-tool vector networks with node handles on grid paper
imagery.graphic_elements: real product screenshots (dark editor UI) as the hero proof; near-black generative shader-art blog covers (pixel grids, chrome diamond, glowing badges); grayscale customer logo clouds; the Z app icon squircle
imagery.pattern_usage: grid-paper and ruler ticks as recurring drafting patterns; stepped-noise/pixel patterns inside generative covers
imagery.image_shape: sharp-rectangle screenshots with slight rounding inside hairline frames; cover art is always dark against the light page

interaction_feel.feedback_style: physical and keyboard-native — buttons are keycaps with a bottom edge that reads as pressable; every primary action advertises its shortcut
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: subtle tonal steps and blue ink shifts; links underline/darken; nothing scales or bounces
interaction_feel.transition_personality: snappy 150ms ease; page-frame transitions glide at 400ms; ambient shaders drift continuously underneath
interaction_feel.loading_style: minimal; content is static HTML-first, effects layer in after
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: low count, high intent — copy-to-clipboard on install commands, segmented release toggles, keycap hints everywhere

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: witty, confident, craft-obsessed engineer-speak: 'Your last next editor', 'Built with ultimate care', 'Code at the speed of thought', 'Daily drive with Zed'
brand_voice_in_ui.formality: casual-precise; sentence case everywhere, no exclamation marks, no superlative spam — speed claims are stated as fact
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative pairs with keyboard shortcuts: 'Download now D', 'Clone source C', 'Get Started'
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: the 404 is a designed object — blue vector-node '404' artwork + 'Page Not Found' serif + a helpful 'let us know' link

overview.effect_intensity: subtle-accent — real WebGL2 shader work, deliberately turned down to a whisper (5–15% opacity, edge-masked)
overview.performance_tier: heavy-under-the-hood: four full-bleed WebGL2 GLSL canvases plus one Canvas-2D element on the homepage; presented as lightweight ambience
overview.fallback_strategy: effects are decorative-only: all content is readable HTML/CSS without them; dark mode dims canvases further (opacity-15 → dark:opacity-8)
overview.primary_technology: WebGL2 fragment shaders (#version 300 es, u_time-driven; Paper-Shaders-style programs — mesh gradient with swirl+grain, neuro-noise flow, voronoi cells, stepped simplex noise, polygon dot-grid) + CSS animation utilities

background_effects.description: large WebGL2 canvases absolutely positioned behind hero/section content at opacity-5/12/15 with bottom fade masks (mask-b-from-20% mask-b-to-80%); they render drifting grainy gradients/noise in paper-and-blue tones, giving the 'paper' its living grain
background_effects.technology: WebGL2 GLSL (28 shader programs bundled; uniforms include u_time, u_swirl, u_grainMixer/u_grainOverlay, u_stepsPerColor, u_softness, u_spreading)

params.color_palette: cream/offgray/blue family sampled from the page theme
params.density: fine film-grain + large soft noise fields
params.blend_mode: normal at low alpha over the paper background

particle_systems.description: /ai hero shows a sparse rain of faint monospaced numerals drifting down behind the headline ('AI coding at native speed') — matrix-rain turned papery and near-invisible

3d_elements.description: no 3D models or WebGL geometry scenes; depth is faked with soft shadows on screenshots and the app icon

shader_effects.type: custom-GLSL ambient programs (mesh-gradient, neuro-noise, voronoi, stepped-noise, dot-grid)
shader_effects.description: the shader library doubles as the blog-cover art generator: near-black covers with glowing stepped pixel grids, chrome-gem gradients, and badge lockups are rendered variants of the same noise/stepped-color programs
shader_effects.technology: WebGL2, GLSL ES 3.00, value/simplex noise, fwidth-antialiased stepped color quantization

params.uniforms: u_time, u_colors[], u_colorsCount, u_swirl, u_distortion, u_grainMixer, u_grainOverlay, u_stepsPerColor, u_softness, u_size, u_spreading, u_dotSize, u_gapX/u_gapY
params.fragment_output: grain-modulated multi-color gradients and stepped noise fields

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: section bands as they enter the viewport

scroll_morphing.description: no scroll-driven morphs; the page frame itself can transform/border-radius over 400ms (mobile menu sheet behavior), not scroll-linked

text_effects.description: headlines are static ink; the typography itself (serif italic + typewriter body) carries the expressiveness

cursor_effects.description: standard cursors; keyboard shortcuts are the site's power-user channel instead of cursor theatrics

image_effects.description: screenshots and covers sit still inside their hairline frames; no hover distortion or reveal clips

canvas_drawings.description: one 142x142 Canvas-2D element (pointer-events-none, opacity-15) sits as a decorative mark; the heavy lifting is all WebGL2

params.animation_loop: subtle/none observed; CSS spin-slow (32s/50s) utilities exist for decorative rotation

svg_animations.description: the 404 page's '404' is drawn as an interactive-style vector network (blue stroke paths with diamond node handles, Figma-pen-tool aesthetic) over grid paper; logo and icons are static SVG

visual_effects.composite_notes: Zed's effect strategy is inversion: the marketing layer is dead-calm paper while GPU shaders hum underneath at 5-15% opacity — an apt metaphor for an editor whose brand is 'native speed you can feel but not see'. The same GLSL noise/stepped-color programs generate the dark blog covers, so one shader system serves both ambient backgrounds and published artwork. Signature non-shader effects are physical, not digital: keycap buttons with inset bottom edges, kbd shortcut chips on every CTA, ruler ticks and grid-paper margins, and the vector-node 404. When recreating this DNA, spend the budget on typography fidelity (Plex Serif variable italic + iA Writer Quattro) and the hairline page frame before adding any shader; a static grain PNG at 10% opacity captures 90% of the effect.
